|strategy=By [mailto:bobafett@powerup.com.au Michael Sharp], Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20010418093143/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/limitedresources.html</ref>

Make a decisive blow to your opponent by playing a number of [[Limited Resources]] in your turn!

Wait until your opponent gets down to two cards in their hand. This can happen after your round of Force Drains, or if the opponent returns their cards by [[Traffic Control]]. Once they are down to two, pounce by playing as many of these as you can as the Interrupt is unrestricted. Play in your turn, as their loss is four instead of just two.

The destiny value of 5 is very handy as well! A good number is between 3-5 in a deck.
